{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_zoom_ops_policy", "thread_id": "thread_zoom_ops", "from_": "ops@company.example.com", "to": ["sales@company.example.com"], "subject": "Zoom meeting requirements for demos", "date": "2026-02-10T09:00:00Z", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true}
消息 ID：msg_zoom_ops_policy
来源：ops@company.example.com
收件人：sales@company.example.com
日期：2026-02-10T09:00:00Z
主题：Zoom meeting requirements for demos
Team,

All product demos must have a waiting room enabled and a passcode set. This is required for security compliance.

Also, all demo Zoom meetings must have the topic format: 'Demo: <Opportunity Name>'.

IMPORTANT: Do NOT schedule demos for accounts that have 'Account Status: On Hold' in their Salesforce description. These accounts are temporarily paused. If the target account has On Hold status, skip demo scheduling and notify the AE.

- Ops Team"}
